name: iterative_refine_loop
description: Loop workflow: a review node routes back to itself while the draft is not yet good enough. Demonstrates RETRY/self-loop edges, retry budget, convergence and the max_iterations safety valve — all from data.

verdict.instructions: Given the current draft and the number of revision rounds already spent, should we accept it, revise once more, or escalate to a human editor?

criteria.accept: the draft is good enough to send as-is
criteria.revise: it can be improved by another revision round
criteria.escalate: it needs a human editor's judgement

quality.instructions: How good is the current draft?
